sentences.text:
1  3. By this application, the applicant seeks his enlargement  in connection with C.R. No. 570/2021 registered with the Pandharpur  Taluka Police Station, Solapur, for the alleged offences punishable  Wakodikar   8a. BA 3484-2021.
Sections 328, 188, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections  26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(e), 59 r/w 3(1)(zz)(iii) of Food Safety and  Standards Act.
4. Perused the papers.

According to the complainant-Bharath  Bhosale, the Foods Safety Officer, Food and Drugs Department, Solapur,
 on 8th September 2021, he along with the police staff, visited Panchwati  Paan Shop at Sargam Chowk, Pandharpur, Solapur.
In the search that was  carried out, paan masala and supari worth Rs. 605/- was seized.
The  applicant is stated to be the owner of the said Panchwati Paan Shop.
5. Having regard to the facts, prima facie, it is doubtful whether  an offence under Section 328 is disclosed qua the applicant.
The applicant  is in custody since 8th September 2021.
In the facts, further detention of t  applicant is not warranted.
6. Accordingly, the application is allowed and the applicant is  enlarged on bail, on the following terms and conditions :

sentences.text: (v) The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence or attempt to influence or contact the complainant, witnesses or any person concerned with the case.
7. The application is accordingly disposed of in the aforesaid terms.

It is made clear that the observations made herein are prima facie, and the trial Court shall decide the case on its own merits, in accordance with law, uninfluenced by the observations made in this order.

9. All concerned to act on the authenticated copy of this order.
REVATI MOHITE DERE, J.
